name: Nginx
author: grandpaacademy
description: Nginx web server / reverse proxy. Place your nginx.conf in /home/container/nginx.conf.
startup:
if [ ! -f /home/container/nginx.conf ]; then mkdir -p /home/container/www; echo '

Nginx is running!

' > /home/container/www/index.html; echo 'worker_processes auto; events { worker_connections 1024; } http { include /etc/nginx/mime.types; default_type application/octet-stream; sendfile on; server { listen ${SERVER_PORT:-80}; root /home/container/www; index index.html; location / { try_files $uri $uri/ =404; } } }' > /home/container/nginx.conf; fi; exec nginx -g 'daemon off;' -c /home/container/nginx.conf

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash # Nginx Install Script apt update apt install -y nginx curl jq mkdir -p /mnt/server mkdir -p /mnt/server/www echo '

Nginx is running!

' > /mnt/server/www/index.html echo -e "install complete" exit 0
